title: Reverse Linked List

statement.hi: Singly linked list ka `head` diya hai. List ko **reverse** karo aur naya head return karo.
statement.en: Given the `head` of a singly linked list, **reverse** the list and return the new head.

hi: Har node ka `next` ulta karke `prev` ki taraf point karao.

approach.hi: Iterative: `prev = null` se shuru karo. Har step pe `next` save karo, `cur->next = prev` karo, phir `prev` aur `cur` ko aage badhao. End me `prev` naya head hai. O(n) time, O(1) space.
approach.en: Iterative: start with `prev = null`. At each step save `next`, set `cur->next = prev`, then advance `prev` and `cur`. At the end `prev` is the new head. O(n) time, O(1) space.
